blocks.text: SAN ANTONIO, Zambales — A 30-hectare forestland in Palauig, Zambales, has been designated for tree planting and rehabilitation under a government reforestation program, the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) Central Luzon said on Monday. The area in Sitio Dampay, Barangay Salaza, will be adopted under the National Greening Program (NGP) through an agreement among the DENR, Giga Ace 8 Inc. and the Forest Guardians of Palauig Association Inc. (FGPAI). Giga Ace 8, a subsidiary of ACEN Corporation, is involved in solar power development in Palauig. FGPAI is a local people’s organization that will take part in the forestland adoption. […]...
